title: Matibag: NBI will also check Paolo Duterte’s SALN

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) will also check on the Statements of Assets, Liabilities and Net Worth (SALN) of Davao City First District Rep. Paolo Duterte, according to Director Melvin Matibag. Matibag said this in a press conference on Thursday after mentioning that a mansion near a resort—not the resort itself—on Samal Island in Davao del Norte was found to be owned by Duterte.
